summary: Phase 5 (Member Import, Quarterly Gatherings, Annual Summary, Sisterhood Spotlight) - full backend regression + admin UI smoke. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_members_phase5.py (32 pytest cases) - ALL 32 PASS. Covered: security (anon 401 on /members/gatherings|annual-reports|spotlight; member 403 on /admin/members/annual|spotlights|import/validate); import preview parses CSV, flags bad email/future-join/bad-birthday errors + no-join/referrer-not-found warnings, matches referrer by name-in-file (Dee -> qa.imp.dee@example.com); /import/validate re-check turns bad -> clean after email fix; /import/commit creates/updates (idempotent re-commit) and links referrer, imported members visible via admin APIs and directory; gatherings PUT sets rsvp_deadline + details, member RSVP yes+2guests + maybe recorded, headcount yes=1 total=3 maybe=1 and dietary 'vegetarian' aggregated, invalid response 400, _send_gathering_reminders stamps rsvp_reminder_sent_at and dedupes (n2==0); annual data shape membership/attendance/dues/support/votes, share returns id -> member sees in /members/annual-reports -> unshare returns 404 on report GET; spotlight: /media?category=spotlight returns [], staff mode create+publish works and 2nd create for same published month -> 400, publish without story -> 400, invite mode creates invited row visible to invited member only, uninvited member upload photo -> 403, foreign https photo url on submit -> 400, submit without photo OK -> status=submitted -> admin publish OK, invalid month '2026-13' and nonexistent user -> 400. Regression: all 9 member GET endpoints and 7 admin GET endpoints still 200. Frontend: Playwright confirmed all 11 members sub-tabs render (import/meetings/annual/spotlight/people/dues/votes/support/december/treasurer/referrers); AdminImport shows import-template-btn + import-file-input (import-invite-toggle correctly hidden until a file is uploaded - rendered conditionally); AdminAnnual shows annual-year-select, annual-body, annual-open-print, annual-share-btn; AdminSpotlight shows spotlight-form, spotlight-sister, spotlight-month, spotlight-create-btn, spotlight-use-profile with staff/invite mode toggles; /annual-report?year=2026 bare printable renders annual-report, annual-year, annual-print-btn; member portal tabs people/news/minutes/votes present and portal loads cleanly for mem_tok_a (test-created QA gathering was deleted in teardown so no live gathering-card at screenshot time - RSVP flow fully covered by backend tests).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 8359 lines (phase 5 added ~550). The phase-5 block is self-contained enough to extract into backend/members/{import,gatherings,annual,spotlight}.py routers plus a shared _parse_date util.

_valid_photo in admin_spotlight_edit (line 8249) accepts any https:// url for admin edits ('not _valid_photo(payload.photo_url) and not payload.photo_url.startswith("https://")'). That means admins can set an arbitrary external image URL that bypasses the /api/media id check used elsewhere. Minor risk (admin-only path), but inconsistent with the create endpoint which requires a /api/media/file URL via _valid_photo. Consider also validating the hostname or at least restricting to local uploads.
_read_import_file silently truncates to 1000 rows (line 7873). Larger club rosters would be partially imported with no warning returned. Suggest returning a 'truncated' flag or 400 if rows > 1000.

_send_gathering_reminders iterates all active members per meeting and awaits each send_email sequentially (lines 8098-8109). Same pattern flagged in iteration_25 for agenda reminders - consider asyncio.gather with semaphore.
member_annual_reports upsert uses year as the natural key but no unique index enforced on {year}. Low-risk but double-click share could create duplicate rows if the first upsert hits a race.

SpotlightIn allows empty 'story' on create (status='draft' or 'invited') but publish requires story - good. However PUT /admin/members/spotlights/{sid} does not re-check that the sister is still active (user may have been removed), and does not update 'name' snapshot if the user's name changed later.
/members/gatherings returns at most 10 rows sorted by date; 'quarterly' plus other in-person meetings over a year could exceed 10. Make limit configurable or document the cap.

_valid_photo pattern '^/api/media/file/[A-Za-z0-9-]+$' - uuid4 hex isn't just [A-Za-z0-9-] when stored as uuid4() string (which is correct) but if any media id ever contains underscores, validator rejects valid uploads.

Both annual_share and spotlight create silently depend on await send_email which may fail; failures are logged but not surfaced in the response. Consider returning a soft warning when the email broadcast failed so staff can retry.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed phase-5 data-testids present and functional

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 fully functional. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_members_phase5.py (32 tests, run with pytest -n 0 since fixtures share module state and db cleanup is ordering-sensitive). BEFORE: python3 /app/backend/tests/qa_session.py up && python3 /app/backend/tests/qa_members.py up. The session-scoped fixture 'ensure_members_active' re-invites both QA emails so /members/me auto-activates - this must run before any phase-5 tests because qa_members.down wipes member_invites. AFTER: qa_members.py down && qa_session.py down. One date edge-case to remember: use server._today_et() (not date.today()) when computing _send_gathering_reminders target dates because the container clock is UTC but ET lags by 4-5 hours - a UTC-today+7 meeting would miss the ET-today+7 reminder window. Phase 1-4 regression suites (test_members_portal.py, test_members_phase2.py, test_members_phase3.py, test_members_phase4.py) remain green.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found. Two test fixes self-applied during iteration: (1) switched reminder-dedupe test to server._today_et() to correct UTC/ET boundary mismatch; (2) relaxed commit assertion from created>=2 to (created+updated)>=2 so repeated runs after prior QA imports still pass.
